data.body: Triage (orphan sweep): RESOLVED — closed as duplicate. The runaway-loop breaker landed and is live on main @9bdb22f5887: src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py:144-197 _runaway_guard_toolsets wraps every toolset, computes usage_log.window_distinct_ratio once per run_step, and raises RunawayToolLoopError BEFORE the repeated call executes; the message names the most-repeated signature and never advises raising REBAR_LLM_MAX_STEPS. Classified/recovered at src/rebar/llm/structured_run.py:107 and src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py:400. Both tickets this was consolidated into are closed: c827-2a23-cd00-473e and epic 9b71-55b3-1bd1-4a97. Note: this ticket's literal ACs (consecutive-repeat threshold, default <10) were deliberately superseded by the windowed distinct-ratio detector, per its own second comment.
